policy: The predeployment audit budgets the verified September 6 deploy surface. The canonical Methodologylist, methodology section, CORE+ section, and gorgonification section use measured September 6 baselines with narrow headroom for deliberate edits. Other large canonical reference pages, the complete server-rendered Teacher Resources finder, and full localized Leizu compositions retain their existing explicit ceilings. Any new HTML above 350 KB requires a documented budget entry. September 28 final fixes retain existing ceilings except the measured complete CampaignCodex archive and add the previously missing complete-module exception. No source content is removed to satisfy a byte limit. October 5 ML concept-application amendment: refresh only measured ML reference baselines and the narrow ceilings exceeded by the authorized existing-owner extensions; retain every unrelated budget and global/type ceiling.
